title: Spain Company Profile
description: Country-specific combined company profile for Spain. Open spine = BORME (BOE open-data API, official acts) + OpenMercantil (CC-BY reconstructed master). Identity/events are open; share capital and the sole-shareholder case come from BORME acts. financial_statements[] is multi-source: CNMV (open XBRL, LISTED issuers only) and the Registro Mercantil 'Depósito de Cuentas Anuales' (XBRL, PAID per company ~€9-20, general population — planning-only). Primary key is NIF/CIF when present (sparse in open data, ~18%), else the Hoja registral (province+number), else name+province.

registration.description: Spanish register identity. CIF is the tax id and best key but is sparse in open data; the Hoja registral (province letters + number) is the stable open key from BORME.

cif.description: Spanish tax id (CIF/NIF). Best join key; ~18% populated in open data.

hoja_registral.description: Registry sheet (province letters + number), e.g. 'AL 52199'. Stable open key when CIF is absent.

province.description: Province of the registering mercantile registry.

company_type.description: Legal form (SL, SA, SLU, SCP, ...) derived from the name suffix / CIF leading letter.

normalized_name.description: Name with status/registry tags and form suffix stripped.

derived.description: From BORME Disolución/Extinción acts and name suffixes (e.g. 'EN LIQUIDACION').

registered_location.description: Activity (CNAE) is NOT in the open BORME/OpenMercantil data without parsing the Constitución objeto social; treat CNAE as derived/enrichment.

share_capital.description: Registered share capital from BORME Constitución / Ampliación de capital acts. This is REGISTER capital, NOT annual-accounts data.

officers.description: Administrators / auditor / liquidator / apoderado from BORME acts. CONTAINS PERSONAL DATA (GDPR).

role.description: Adm. Unico/Solidario/Mancomunado, Consejero, Liquidador, Auditor, Apoderado.

ownership.description: Open ownership in Spain is limited to the SOLE-SHAREHOLDER case (Declaración de unipersonalidad). No general cap table is open. Beneficial ownership (Titularidades Reales) is restricted.

sole_shareholder.description: Socio único (PERSONAL DATA if a natural person).

financial_statements.description: Annual accounts. MULTI-SOURCE: 'cnmv' = open XBRL but LISTED issuers only; 'registro_mercantil' = XBRL for the general population but PAID per company (~€9-20), no bulk (planning-only). revenue/net_result/employees are nullable for small PGC models (abreviado/PYME/microempresa).

revenue.description: Importe neto de la cifra de negocios — nullable for micro.
revenue.x-source-path: Importe neto de la cifra de negocios

source.description: Which financial source produced this record.

acts.description: Raw BORME acts linked to the company (event history).

source_provenance.description: One entry per source contributing to this profile.
